name: Displacement Reaction Setup (Iron in Copper Sulphate)
semanticDescription: Laboratory demonstration setup of single displacement reaction where an iron nail suspended by thread in copper sulphate solution displaces copper, developing a reddish-brown copper deposit while the blue solution fades to light green (CBSE Class 10 Chemistry Ch 1 Activity 1.9).
simplifications: Solution color shows transitional blue-green state.
Copper coating on iron nail shown with characteristic reddish-brown metallic texture.

materials.look: Aqueous translucent blue-green copper/iron sulphate solution
Machined metallic iron nail (grey, metallic 0.9, roughness 0.3)
Polished beechwood laboratory test tube stand
